references.text: Israel was oppressed by Eglon, king of Moab, for eighteen years – the same period as the oppression in Gilead.
Sisera oppressed the people of Israel for twenty years, a similar pattern of prolonged oppression.
Israel was given into the hand of the Midianites because of their sin, following the same pattern of God's judgment on Israel.
The context of the oppression – Israel served foreign gods, and the Lord sold them to the Philistines and the Ammonites.
The Ammonites went to war against Israel, which led to Jephthah being brought in to lead Israel against them.
Describes the land of the Amorites east of the Jordan, which the Israelites conquered under Moses.
The curses in the covenant included that a foreign nation would oppress Israel if they were disobedient.
Gilead was given as an inheritance to half the tribe of Manasseh, the area that was now being oppressed.
